clusters.name: Your grandfather Gordon's death, 1989–1994
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather Gordon's death in June 1991, within three years: your move to Quarry Lane in spring 1989, your late nights and anxiety rising through secondary school, your wrist injury stopping your playing in October 1991, a blow-up with your closest friend Rafe and your retreat into getting high, your functioning falling as you lost your footing with him gone and your mother about to remarry, your grandmother Winifred's thyroid surgery within a year of his death, and your bleak year at community college following. Your father came back into the family around the same time Clifford returned. Your shift toward your father in January 1994 and your exchange in Lisbon show the period settling as you found your drive again.

clusters.name: Your grandmother Winifred's death, 2001–2004
clusters.reason: Around your grandmother Winifred's bowel cancer diagnosis in 2001 or 2002, within three years: your anxiety rising and functioning falling as you ran out of steam for performing, your disastrous audition in early 2002 where you were done with it all, your distance from your parents by September 2002, your move away from Thornbury and then your move with Marisol in 2003, your split with Marisol and deep depression that winter, your anxiety rising as you could not face your family, your reliance on friends Corbin, Dale and Silas, your parents' involvement once you asked for help with therapy, and your grandmother's death in February 2004 while she was in your parents' home. Your return to your therapist Victor Halloran and beginning to swim mark the settling.

clusters.name: Your grandmother Lorna's death, 2008–2010
clusters.reason: Around your grandmother Lorna's death in January 2008 and your grandfather Clifford's death in early 2008, within two years: your distance from your mother during four weeks building at Alder Creek in July 2008, her anxiety rising as she pressed you to visit and your conflict over the door, your cutoff from your mother when you moved to nursing school in September 2008, and your aunt Imogen's stroke in early 2009 with rehabilitation. The birth of Poppy in 2010 marks the settling.

clusters.name: Your marriage to Wren, 2017–2019
clusters.reason: Around your marriage to Wren in March 2017, within two and a half years: your distance from your mother as you saw her less once Wren came along, your cousin Alice's diagnosis with multiple sclerosis in October 2017, your aunt Imogen's memory slipping worse and lashing out at her son Hal, your sister Tara's wedding and your move to Rennick for her airline work, your job steadying that paid well in June 2019, and the upheaval of late October 2019 when your partner Wren was swamped with one thing after another—a street party, a dinner, then the drive to her mother's retirement party at the lake. Your anxiety rose and your functioning fell as you overfunctioned laying out a plan; you were awake from the small hours at the lake weekend with no more sleep, pulling back from the others as they rose, and your anxiety held as your partner grew anxious too. Your normal state of constant pressure to drive projects forward and your move to shorter regular calls with your mother through October show the period settling into a new balance.
